intro: We’re a growing restaurant and catering brand in Uyo, and we’re looking for people who love food, service and building something that lasts.
howToApply: Send an email stating the position you’re applying for, with all relevant documents attached. Or send your CV to us on WhatsApp.

positions.title: Business Development Manager
summary: Some people wait for opportunities. Others create them. At Gourmet Gather, we’re looking for the second kind.

We’re searching for a Business Development Manager (Female) who understands that growth doesn’t happen by chance. It happens because someone is constantly looking for the next customer, the next partnership, the next idea and the next opportunity.

This role isn’t about waiting for instructions. It’s about taking initiative, building relationships, opening doors, and helping a growing food brand become the first name people think of for great food and exceptional catering in Uyo.
If you’re organised, strategic, dependable and excited about building something that lasts, we’d love to hear from you.
